properties.name: retail.ui.theme
properties.description: Name of the theme for the UI

properties.name: retail.ui.disable-demo-warnings
properties.description: Disable the UI messages warning about demonstration content

properties.name: retail.ui.product-images-path
properties.description: Overrides the location where the sample product images are sourced from to use the specified file path

properties.name: retail.ui.endpoints.catalog
properties.description: HTTP endpoint for the catalog service

properties.name: retail.ui.endpoints.carts
properties.description: HTTP endpoint for the carts service

properties.name: retail.ui.endpoints.checkout
properties.description: HTTP endpoint for the checkout service

properties.name: retail.ui.endpoints.orders
properties.description: HTTP endpoint for the orders service

properties.name: retail.ui.endpoints.assistant
properties.description: HTTP endpoint for the assistant service. Required when retail.ui.chat.provider is assistant; if empty the product page shows no similar products

properties.name: retail.ui.chat.temperature
properties.description: Chat assistant model temperature (only for the mock, openai and bedrock providers)

properties.name: retail.ui.chat.max-tokens
properties.description: Chat assistant model maximum output tokens (only for the mock, openai and bedrock providers)

properties.name: retail.ui.chat.provider
properties.description: Chat assistant provider: mock, openai, bedrock or assistant

properties.name: retail.ui.chat.model
properties.description: Chat assistant model provider model ID (only for the mock, openai and bedrock providers)

properties.name: retail.ui.assistant.connect-timeout
properties.description: Timeout to open a connection with the assistant service

properties.name: retail.ui.assistant.chat-timeout
properties.description: Total time limit of a chat turn forwarded to the assistant service

properties.name: retail.ui.assistant.keepalive-interval
properties.description: Interval between SSE keepalive comments sent to the browser during a chat turn

properties.name: retail.ui.assistant.similar-k
properties.description: Number of similar products shown in the product page

properties.name: retail.ui.assistant.similar-timeout
properties.description: Time limit to fetch the similar products of the product page
